query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL) as with_qid,
  SUM(wikidata_qid IS NULL) as without_qid,
  ROUND(SUM(wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as pct
FROM traditions_olfactives;
